 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. SWAC title aspirations are at stake when Alabama State football takes on Jackson State at ASU Stadium on Saturday, Nov. 14 (2 p.m. CT, ESPN+).
 Jackson State sits atop the SWAC East with a head-to-head tiebreaker advantage over Alabama A&M, but Alabama State isn't completely out of the race . The Hornets are currently tied with Bethune-Cookman for third place in the SWAC East. Alabama State needs a win and for Alabama A&M and Bethune-Cookman to lose to stay alive in the race.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Both teams don't need SWAC title stakes to get motivation for what is turning into a rivalry game between two teams that have frequently been picked to win the SWAC in the last five years.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement What happened last time Alabama State and Jackson State met
 02:01 PM ET, November 14 2026, Jaeden Day 
 To say the last meeting between Alabama State and Jackson State was a thriller, would almost been an understatement. It was game that came down the final two seconds in regulation. The Hornets had the ball on the Jackson State 2-yard line, and a touchdown would give the Hornets complete control of the SWAC. Alabama State called a passing play to the short side of the field and Jackson State read it perfectly to keep the Hornets out of the end zone. Jackson State won 38-34 at Veterans Memorial Stadium.
 The Tigers have won the last two meetings. Four out of the last six meetings between Alabama State and Jackson State have been one score games. 21-of-52 games in the entire series have been decided by one score.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Is there some quarterback controversy at Alabama State?
 01:30 PM ET, November 14 2026, Jaeden Day 
 On Wednesday, Nov. 11, Alabama State coach Eddie Robinson Jr. announced that Andrew Body was cleared to play with a brace he's wearing on his non-throwing wrist. Body suffered a bone injury to his left wrist in a game against Troy on Sept. 12. Since Body's absence, it's been true freshman Aaron Frye taking the mantle of starting quarterback.
 Robinson said that he wants to play Body to an extent against Jackson State, but it would hinge on how Body handled practice on Thursday and Friday. But the Alabama state coach also said that the Hornet offense in 2026 was Frye's to command the rest of the season. Frye won national honors in both the SWAC and the FCS against Texas Southern the week prior.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement With both Alabama State and Jackson State playing for SWAC title hopes, is Robinson going to keep to his word? Or was the coach just putting up a smoke screen. The Hornets' first offensive drive could be telling.
 What will the weather be like for Alabama State vs. Jackson State?
 01:01 PM ET, November 14 2026, Jaeden Day 
 Make sure to bring something warm to wear or cozy up in because even though the game will be sunny, the high for the game is 59 degrees with a wind at 5 mph according to the National Weather Forecast. The sun is expected to begin setting at 4:45 p.m., which means the later half of the game could be even colder than the start.
